source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule reissue
source.note: Read from Volkswagen's 2012–2013 USA maintenance schedules, as reissued in 11/2025, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the booklet that came with your car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedule for its models, as Volkswagen reissued it on its owners' literature site, for a car the owner maintains. Only the Beetle 2.5L's facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
